gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-cuneifo: Soft, puffy lowercase with an e that opens up rather than closing its eye. Noto Sans Cuneiform sits beneath Grandstander, whose letters look cut from equal-width strips, so the two feel like rounded beads under flat ribbons.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-devanag: Noto Sans Devanagari keeps a compact skyline where capitals blend into lowercase, with a g whose lower curve stays open. Grandstander supplies the hook: steady pen pressure from first letter to last.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Chunky, hairline-free strokes define Grandstander, so its stems match every other stroke in the letter. But Noto Sans Ethiopic does the quiet work, its tall, sturdy lowercase carrying the text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Fat, nozzle-pulled strokes up top, then big glass-bead counters below: Grandstander and Noto Sans Gothic make a chunky couple. Its round, parenthesis-like forms keep a sans-serif paragraph open and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Crayon-thick and cheerful, with not a hairline anywhere in sight. Grandstander keeps its strokes free of shadow, while Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Grandstander draws flat, unmodulated strokes with short ascenders and a loud, friendly manner. Noto Sans Hebrew, a plain sans, lets its big midsection and wide curve gaps carry paragraphs without strain.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-hk: Grandstander gives its diagonals the same heft as its horizontals, a stout, bold look. And Noto Sans HK, a sans-serif with large lowercase and lifted brush ends, keeps reading light and tidy.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-imperia: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads crisp, its c ends flaring apart like pincers. Grandstander, with no visible difference between up and side strokes, shouts above while the sans-serif text keeps capitals close in height to lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-kayah-l: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads clean, with lifted brush ends. Its capitals stand only slightly above the lowercase, so text runs smoothly under Grandstander, whose bars match its stems in heft.
